Qual a missão do Cargo?

Estamos em busca de um Especialista em Dados proativo para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional ideal será responsável por transformar dados brutos em insights valiosos, construindo soluções robustas de engenharia de dados e visualização.   • Desenhar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados que transferem, transformam e carregam dados de diversas fontes.

  • Experiência em Engenharia de Dados: Habilidade para projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados eficientes, garantindo a qualidade e a integridade das informações.

  • Conhecimento em AWS: Experiência prática com serviços AWS, especialmente AWS Glue para processos de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) e arquiteturas de Data Lake para armazenamento e processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com BigQuery: Domínio da ferramenta, visando operar os dados atuais e desenhar e propor melhorias na organização e qualidade dos mesmos.
  • SQL: Domínio de SQL para consulta e manipulação de dados em diferentes bancos de dados.
  • Comunicação: Excelente capacidade de se comunicar com times técnicos e não técnicos, explicando conceitos complexos de forma simples e direta.
Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?
  • Visualização de Dados: Proficiência na criação de dashboards e relatórios interativos. Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de mercado como Looker Studio, Quick Sight ou similares.
  • Análise de Dados: Capacidade de analisar conjuntos de dados complexos, identificar tendências e traduzir descobertas em recomendações claras para as áreas de negócio.

Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

description:
Join to apply for the DevOps Engineer (Senior/Lead) ID43756 role at AgileEngine

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

As a Lead DevOps Engineer , you’ll own and evolve cloud infrastructure that powers AI-driven products, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across distributed systems. You’ll lead modernization efforts in AWS, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and champion automation and observability best practices. This role combines hands‑on technical leadership with strategic impact, offering the opportunity to shape infrastructure standards and drive innovation in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.

What You Will Do
  • Lead the design, maintenance, and evolution of AWS‑based infrastructure (ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, CDK).
  • Upgrade AWS Aurora Postgres clusters to the latest supported versions, ensuring high availability and data integrity.
  • Enhance and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for production deployments, including support for Lambda functions and microservices.
  • Manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and implement automation best practices.
  • Consolidate and optimize utility scripts and shared tooling across multiple repositories.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to drive DevOps culture, automation, and observability.
Must Haves
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) , including project ownership or leadership roles.
  • Strong expertise with AWS services (ECS, RDS/Aurora, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, CDK).
  • Proficient with Docker, GitHub Actions , and CI/CD best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of Postgres administration , including upgrades, backups, and performance tuning.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills with TypeScript, Python, or Bash .
  • Proven ability to architect scalable, secure, and reliable cloud environments.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Self‑driven, detail‑oriented, and passionate about delivering high‑quality results.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.
Nice to Haves
  • Familiarity with AI/ML workflows or cloud‑based AI services.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock or similar generative AI platforms.
  • Exposure to Cursor or other modern AI‑enhanced developer tools.
  • Understanding of security and scaling best practices for distributed environments.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.). Perks and Benefits
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flex‑time: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Mid‑Senior level

title: Coordenador(a) de Suprimentos - Suporte a Compras
description:
Coordenador(a) de Suprimentos – Suporte a Compras

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Lead accountant (brazil) - sqm iodine & plant nutrition
description: SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition   , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.  Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.  This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a  Accounting Lead  for our office in  Campinas, Brazil.  YOUR MISSION  Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.  WHAT YOU’LL DO  Bank Management  Receive, review, and process invoice payments.  Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.  Prepare bank reconciliations.  Third-Party Management  Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.  Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.  Credit and Commercial Control  Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.  Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.  Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.  Control and monitor customer credit lines.  Inventory Management  Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.  Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).  Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).  Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16) Control recorded fixed assets.  Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.  Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.  Payroll Management  Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.  Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.  Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.  General Accounting  Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.  Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.  Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.  Manage accounting structures and taxes.  Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.  Other Routine Activities  Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.  Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.  Monitor and follow up on internal control.  Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.  Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.  Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.  Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.  Prepare employment certificates.  Fill out forms for supplier registration.  Follow up on requirements from control entities.  Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.  THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED  Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC) Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS) Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.  Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.  Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.  Advanced proficiency in Excel  Desirable use of Odoo  Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS  Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures  Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.  WE OFFER:  Permanent hiring    Working day: Monday to Friday  Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil  The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning  At  SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition  we are committed to the  Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015) , so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: Human resources manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Talent Development & Retention  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.  Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.  Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.  Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).  Attracting & Retaining Talent  Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.  Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.  Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.  Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.  Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.  Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture  Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.  Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.  Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.  Compliance and Child Protection  Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.  Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws  Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).  Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.  Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.  Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.  Wellbeing  Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.  Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.  Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.  Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.  Health (physical and mental/emotional) Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.  Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.  Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.  Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS  BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field 5+ years of experience  HR policies, procedures, and best practices  Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA) HR Information Systems (HRIS) Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle  Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking  Professional development and training frameworks  Child protection and safeguarding protocols  Cultural competence and sensitivity.  Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese  Other Skills (Desirable):  Excellent communication (verbal and written) Strong organizational and time management abilities  High attention to detail  Problem-solving and conflict resolution  Interpersonal skills and empathy  Confidentiality and discretion  Data analysis  Adaptability and proactivity  Cultural awareness and sensitivity  Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Sdr outbound
description: Sobre a Mobiis  A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções Saa S para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.  Resumo da função:  Responsável por prospectar ativamente leads qualificados via ligações, identificar oportunidades para os produtos Saa S da Mobiis (TMS, Marketplace de Fretes, APIs, etc.), agendar reuniões ou demonstrações para o time de vendas, e manter o funil de pré-venda saudável.  Principais responsabilidades:  Realizar ligações ativas para empresas potenciais, especialmente embarcadores, transportadoras, operadores logísticos.  Qualificar prospects (identificar dores, orçamento, decisão, timing).  Apresentar brevemente soluções da Mobiis, despertando interesse para demos.  Agendar reuniões / demos com o time de vendas (closers ou gestores de conta).  Registrar todas as interações no CRM (contatos, envio de materiais, follow-up).  Manter follow-up constante com prospects ao longo do ciclo inicial.  Colaborar com marketing para refinar scripts, mensagens de abordagem e campanhas de outbound.  Atingir metas mensais de reuniões agendadas / leads qualificados.  Requisitos obrigatórios:  Experiência prévia em função de SDR, Inside Sales ou telemarketing ativo, preferencialmente em vendas B2 B ou Saa S. title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.  Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.  Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.  Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.  Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:  Instructional Support and Student Learning  Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.  Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.  Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.  Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.  Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.  Student Care and Learning Environment  Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.  Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).  Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.  Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.  Operational and School Support  Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.  Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.  Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.  Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.  Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.  Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.  Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.  Professional Conduct and Growth  Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.  Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.  Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.  Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.  Additional Responsibilities  Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.  Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.  Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.  Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.  Working Conditions  Walk on paths and rough terrain  Lifting backpacks and school materials  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS:  Degree in Pedagogy, preferred  Five years experience working with children, preferred  PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred) English level required: B2 or above  Portuguese level required: B2 or above  Other Skills (Desirable):  Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect  Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment  Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills  Strong professional organization skills  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Senior backend engineering analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.
Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.
Activities
While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:
Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities. Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies. Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., Whats App and SMS channels). Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs. Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
Master integrations and communications using REST APIs . Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!
Requirements Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir. Experience developing RESTful and g RPC APIs . Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns . Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies . Solid understanding of relational databases . Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.
We are looking for people who: Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes. Adapt quickly to change. Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels. In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.
Nice to have: Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure . Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin . Experience with distributed systems and microservices . Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ). Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Phoenix Pub Sub ). Knowledge of No SQL databases (e.g., Postgres, My SQL, Redis, Mongo DB, Elastic Search, etc.).
Benefits Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde. Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance. Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old. Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options. Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities. Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.
Our Hiring Process
In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Analista de operações pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Production supervisor/coordinator - dry-mix mortar & water-based coatings factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:
1. Production Operations & Management
Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE). 2. Team Management & Development
Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team. 3. Quality Management & Control
Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 4. Safety Production & 5 S Management
Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
Promote and maintain 5 S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment. 5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions). Mandatory Requirements:
College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory. Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure. Preferred Qualifications: Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Analista de segurança da informação sênior
description:

Este time é responsável pela defesa cibernética, focando na proteção das nossas infraestruturas e dados contra ameaças e ataques. A missão do Blue Team é garantir a segurança e a integridade dos sistemas da empresa, implementando medidas de proteção avançadas e respondendo proativamente a possíveis incidentes.

Foco em gestão de acessos e identidades, garantindo conformidade e segurança.
Administração e operação de ferramentas de cofre e gerenciamento de acessos privilegiados (PAM).
Atuação com soluções de IAM (Identity and Access Management), incluindo Broadcom e Sail Point.
Na gestão do Security Operations Center (SOC) e na análise de logs do Security Information and Event Management (SIEM);
Monitorar e analisar o tráfego de rede em busca de atividades suspeitas;
Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança para proteger a infraestrutura da empresa;
Realizar testes de vulnerabilidade e avaliações de risco;
Desenvolver e atualizar políticas de segurança e procedimentos de resposta a incidentes;
Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outros departamentos para assegurar uma defesa abrangente e eficaz.
Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

Conceitos de IAM (Identity and Access Management): autenticação, autorização, ciclo de vida de identidades.
Gestão de acessos privilegiados (PAM): entendimento de como controlar e auditar acessos administrativos.
Active Directory / LDAP: estrutura de diretórios e controle de acesso.
Conhecimento em IDM Broadcom e/ou Sail Point: experiência com provisionamento, desprovisionamento e governança de identidades.
Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança como SIEM, ZTNA, firewalls, IDS/IPS, antivírus, entre outros;
Conhecimento no funcionamento e nas ferramentas do SOC;
Conhecimento com práticas de segurança em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud e OCI) e ambientes on-premises;
Conhecimentos em redes e infraestrutura de TI, incluindo configuração, monitoramento e segurança de redes;
Experiência em auditoria interna e gestão de riscos, familiaridade com ferramentas específicas para gestão de compliance e risco;
Familiaridade com frameworks e normativas de segurança como ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, SOx e LGPD;
Conhecimento em análise de vulnerabilidades e acompanhamento de testes de penetração;
Experiencia em campanhas de conscientização em segurança da informação;

title: Senior software test designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?
“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."
Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer
What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?
As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.
Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:
Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
tech events and knowledge sessions.
This will make you better:
contract for indefinite period of time;
an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance; good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.
This will keep you healthy:
a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.
What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.
· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols
with proven track record in software integration and testing.
· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL
· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control
systems like Git and SVN.
· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development
methodologies.
· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology
· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of
hardware-software co-development.
· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-
functional teams.
Roles & Responsibilities
1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

O Analista de Growth Marketing (CRM & Conteúdo) é um cargo para um profissional que utiliza dados para otimizar a jornada do cliente de ponta a ponta. Seu foco é usar a análise (Growth) para identificar oportunidades, criar e otimizar conteúdo (Conteúdo) para atrair e engajar, e gerenciar réguas de relacionamento (CRM) para converter e reter. Este profissional é o principal responsável por conectar nossos canais, automatizar a nutrição de leads e acelerar o funil de marketing.

Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de crescimento para diversos canais de captação de leads, incluindo mídias sociais (Instagram, Linked In), e-mail marketing, Whats App, SEO, SEM, entre outros

Fomentar a inovação e a experimentação contínua, buscando novas maneiras de alcançar e engajar nosso público-alvo
Criar e analisar dashboards, identificar gargalos e propor soluções baseadas em dados

Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e Automação de Marketing (Experiência com Suíte CRM é um diferencial)

Conhecimento em ferramentas de Data Visualization (Looker Studio, Power BI).

Certificações em marketing digital e produção de conteúdo

title: Pessoa coordenadora de marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities. Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs. Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
Master integrations and communications using REST APIs . Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.

Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns . Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies . Solid understanding of relational databases . Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language. We are looking for people who: Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes. Adapt quickly to change. Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels. In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.
Nice to have: Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure . Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin . Experience with distributed systems and microservices . Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ). Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Phoenix Pub Sub ). Knowledge of No SQL databases (e.g., Postgres, My SQL, Redis, Mongo DB, Elastic Search, etc.). title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net

Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Java Developer
description:

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges across multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities:

Required Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Important Information

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in building, optimizing, and managing data pipelines and modern cloud-based data platforms. This role involves designing scalable, secure, and high-performance data ecosystems for global clients while collaborating closely with data scientists, BI teams, and architects. The ideal candidate has experience in big data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud-native services, particularly on Azure OpenAI.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, workflows, and infrastructure issues;
  • Contribute to automation, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for data platforms.


Essential Skills

  • Experience in data engineering, architecture, or ETL development;
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing;
  • Advanced SQL expertise and proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server);
  • Hands-on experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Hadoop, Databricks);
  • Strong knowledge of Azure data services (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks);
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Luigi, Prefect);
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB);
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, partitioning, and query optimization;
  • Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming);
  • Familiarity with MLOps / AI pipelines to support data science workflows;
  • Knowledge of data governance and regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA);
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models;
  • Prior work in a nearshore delivery environment supporting US/European clients;
  • Certifications in cloud platforms or data engineering (AWS Big Data Specialty, Azure Data Engineer Associate, GCP Data Engineer).

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

  • Você deve ser capaz de desenvolver processos ultra-simplificados, criar e liderar ideias, orientar o time de conteúdo e, acima de tudo, não se limitar à execução de demandas, mas sim o responsável por uma direção estratégica própria.
  • Na maior parte do tempo, o seu trabalho será de criação. Você terá à disposição um influenciador 100% focado na marca, dedicado integralmente às produções e disponível para gravações, testes, validações de conteúdo, roteiros, ideias e novos formatos.
  • Você também poderá guiar atores, UGCs, influenciadores e colaboradores na produção de conteúdos estratégicos voltados ao Pobre.
  • Conforme as demandas crescerem ou surgirem necessidades estratégicas, o seu time será ampliado. Você terá autonomia para indicar novos profissionais, desde que atendam aos padrões da marca.
  • É parte do seu trabalho não apenas reduzir o custo de expansão da audiência, mas conseguir qualificar leads das mais diferentes classes sociais, tornando a comunicação mais ativa, consistente e valiosa.
  • É seu dever manter uma comunicação clara, direta e respeitosa, contribuindo com insights estratégicos para capacitar não apenas o seu departamento, mas também o time de produto.


Requisitos:

  • O grande desafio deste processo seletivo é entender se você realmente sabe qual é o direcionamento criativo adequado para a marca do Pobre. Buscamos alguém que já compreenda todas as implicações decorrentes do nome e do tom característico da marca. Alguém que não precisa de explicações óbvias para captar a essência do Pobre e transformá-la em conteúdo de alto impacto.
  • Se você olha para uma marca chamada “Promoções para Pobres” e o seu lado creator não borbulha, este é um importante sinal de que aqui talvez não seja lugar para você.
  • Você precisa compreender que o Pobre jamais será uma marca tradicional. Você terá um grande desafio criativo, precisará estar sempre atualizado. Ser veloz, flexível e saber navegar por tendências é essencial.
  • Se você não se considera cronicamente online, não faz ideia do que é um shitpost, jamais foi heavy user de Twitter/X e é desconectado desses mundos, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você.
  • Organização, autogestão e compromisso com prazos e entregas são inegociáveis. Esperamos maturidade e responsabilidade profissional.
  • Aqui é um lugar de paz. Desenvolver e liderar as equipes, deve ser um processo natural, sempre se comunicando de maneira eficiente, humana e respeitosa.
  • Você precisa entender técnicas avançadas de copywriting, gatilhos mentais e storytelling.
  • Portfólio, formação superior ou domínio de língua estrangeira (especialmente inglês) são bem-vindos, mas não são critérios eliminatórios.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Executivo de Vendas (Brasil)
description:
Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.


Desenvolvemos sistemas de sensores inteligentes e análises de dados avançadas para coletar e processar informações ambientais, contribuindo diretamente para aumentar a resiliência das cidades frente a enchentes e alagamentos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma startup independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 15 cidades em Portugal e no Brasil, em rápida expansão.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem quer vender com propósito e ter impacto positivo no mundo real. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades


  • Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades na Região Sul do Brasil (RS/SC/PR).
  • Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitorização hidrológica e detecção antecipada de inundações.
  • Gerir o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada.
  • Preparar provas de conceito com leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas.
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição para implementação e sucesso do cliente.
  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.
  • Coletar feedback do cliente para o time de produto/engenharia.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou para o setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região de Porto Alegre ou Florianópolis e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Formação em engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia é desejável.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.

description:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.


Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.


ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.


Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.


Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.


Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.


RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.


REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)


O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Vue.js)
description:

This position requires an individual who enjoys having complete ownership of features from conception to production, encompassing database schema changes, backend APIs, and frontend interfaces, all with comprehensive test coverage. We believe in the "you build it, you own it, you ship it" philosophy. You'll work in an environment that values craftsmanship, modern development practices, and strategic use of AI coding assistants to amplify productivity.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across nine countries.


Core Responsibilities

  • Own Features End-to-End: Take complete ownership of features from initial design through production deployment, including database, backend ( .NET), frontend (Vue.js), testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring

  • Mentor: Share knowledge with team members and help elevate the team's technical capabilities
  • Support Your Features: Own the operational health of features you build- troubleshoot issues, monitor performance, and participate in on-call rotation


Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core 8.0 with proper authentication, authorization, and error handling
  • Build responsive user interfaces with Vue.js 3, Vuetify 3, and modern JavaScript patterns
  • Design and implement database schemas and migrations using Dapper and FluentMigrator with SQL Server
