Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills; able to document technical
  • decisions and collaborate effectively
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrable full-stack expertise
  • Strong C# and .NET proficiency: Experience with ASP.NET Core, dependency injection, async/await patterns
  • Modern JavaScript/TypeScript: Solid understanding of ES6+, async programming, and modern frontend frameworks
  • Frontend Framework Experience: Production experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular (Vue.js preferred)
  • SQL Database Expertise: Strong SQL skills, experience with database design, query optimization, and writing efficient SQL queries
  • Docker: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization, local development environments, and understanding container orchestration
  • API Design: Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with proper authentication, versioning, and documentation
  • Testing Mindset: Track record of writing unit tests, integration tests, and maintaining high code coverage
  • Version Control: Proficient with Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, and branching strategies
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the stack
  • Ownership Mentality: Track record of seeing features through from conception to production, including post-deployment support and iteration


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Vue.js 3 (Composition API or Options API) and Vuetify
  • Experience with micro-ORMs like Dapper or similar lightweight data access libraries
  • Familiarity with database migration tools (FluentMigrator, DbUp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architecture patterns and considerations
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Blob Storage, Azure DevOps)
  • Knowledge of message bus patterns (MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)
  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and inter-service communication patterns
  • Background in document management, workflow systems, or enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar identity management platforms
  • Experience working with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) in a production environment


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

About Velozient

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. description:

Este trabalho começaria de forma freelancer , em uma localização remota de escolha do contratado, até que ambas as partes sintam que uma boa relação de trabalho foi estabelecida, após o que a possibilidade de uma posição permanente em tempo integral poderá ser discutida.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing


What You Will Do

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content
  • Work with designers and copywriters: briefs, quality review
  • Adapt content for different audiences and markets
  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Plan and execute webinars end-to-end
  • Launch email campaigns, tripwires, and automated funnels
  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)
  • Produce channel and campaign performance reports
  • Optimize existing marketing activities based on data
  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)


Requirements

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.


You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants


Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:

  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.

Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Informatica Developer
description:
Cargo: Desenvolvedor de Integração de Dados e Integração em Nuvem


Local e Formato de Trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário: Disponibilidade para atuação em Horário da Costa Leste dos EUA (ET)



Resumo da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Informatica Developer qualificado, com experiência em Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) , incluindo Informatica Data Integration e Informatica Cloud Application Integration , para projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de integração de dados.

O candidato ideal deve ter experiência prática na criação de workflows ETL , migração de dados e processos de integração baseados em nuvem , a fim de apoiar iniciativas corporativas de gestão de dados e análise .



Habilidades e Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Inglês Avançado para realizar conversações.
  • Experiência prática comprovada (geralmente 3+ anos ) com Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) , incluindo Cloud Data Integration e Application Integration .
  • Sólido conhecimento em conceitos de ETL , armazenamento de dados (data warehousing) e modelagem de dados .
  • Proficiência em SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais como Oracle , SQL Server ou MySQL .
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe .



Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar mapeamentos, workflows e sessões ETL utilizando Informatica IICS para projetos de integração de dados locais (on-premises).
  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar integrações em tempo real usando APIs REST/SOAP e serviços web .
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de integração de dados utilizando Informatica Cloud (IICS) para tarefas de migração e integração de dados na nuvem .
  • Colaborar com arquitetos de dados , analistas de negócios e outros stakeholders para compreender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas.
  • Otimizar processos ETL visando desempenho, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Identificar e solucionar problemas em jobs ETL e workflows de integração em nuvem para garantir a execução bem-sucedida e entrega dentro dos prazos.
  • Desenvolver e manter documentação técnica , incluindo especificações de design, documentos de mapeamento e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Implementar padrões de segurança e conformidade nos processos de integração.
  • Participar de revisões de código , testes e atividades de implantação .



Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Certificação Informatica CAI (Cloud Application Integration) .
  • Certificação Informatica CDI (Informatica Cloud Data Integration) .
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) será um diferencial.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas .
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração .

title: Gerente de Comunicação | Nordeste
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para liderar a área de Comunicação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor de serviços ambientais. Trata-se de uma posição estratégica, com responsabilidade sobre a gestão integrada da comunicação corporativa, institucional e interna, garantindo coerência, clareza e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Essa é uma oportunidade para quem deseja atuar com protagonismo, em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, com mobilidade nacional — especialmente voltada às operações localizadas na região Nordeste do País.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Planejar e conduzir a estratégia de comunicação da companhia, assegurando consistência e efetividade nas iniciativas internas e externas;
  • Liderar e desenvolver a equipe de comunicação, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e voltado a resultados;
  • Estruturar planos e campanhas institucionais que reforcem a reputação e o posicionamento da marca;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com a imprensa e demais públicos estratégicos, atuando de forma proativa na gestão da imagem e em eventuais situações de crise;
  • Coordenar o desenvolvimento de conteúdos multiplataforma (digital, audiovisual e impresso), fortalecendo a presença institucional da empresa;
  • Apoiar a alta liderança na comunicação de temas estratégicos e no engajamento dos públicos internos;
  • Supervisionar fornecedores e parceiros da área, garantindo qualidade e aderência às diretrizes corporativas;
  • Elaborar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho da área, com foco em melhoria contínua e tomada de decisão.


Requisitos e perfil desejado

  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de comunicação corporativa, com atuação em empresas de grande porte e interface direta com a alta liderança;
  • Vivência em planejamento estratégico, gestão de crises, relacionamento com imprensa e comunicação institucional;
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas complexos em mensagens claras, acessíveis e alinhadas aos diferentes públicos;
  • Perfil estratégico e mão na massa, com visão integrada de negócio e habilidade para navegar em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Mobilidade nacional, com disponibilidade para viagens frequentes — especialmente para atuação nas operações do Nordeste;
  • Formação superior em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação será considerada um diferencial.
